entries.summary: Added jump-to-page navigation and smoother image loading on the Quran page viewer, plus new reference data (Juz/Hizb mappings) laying groundwork for future navigation features.
Completed the full 114-surah reference dataset (names, order, revelation details) and moved the project onto its El-Furkan.al domain branding.
Initial release: browse the full surah index, read individual surah pages, and view scanned Quran mushaf pages with navigation.
